latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — concise integration and troubleshooting guide for the image annotation component.

- Covers integrating @frank17008/image-annotation into React apps, including controlled/uncontrolled usage and custom image upload.
- Details required parent container styling, common pitfalls (like blank canvas), and debugging tips.
- Documents props, annotation types, keyboard shortcuts, and basic styling customization.
- Provides usage patterns for exporting annotations and leveraging toolbar features.
- Includes clear TypeScript usage guidance and typical integration code samples.
